summary: "The Prince and the Pauper, Part 6." by Mark Twain is a novel first published in 1881. When young Prince Edward and pauper Tom Canty swap clothes due to their uncanny resemblance, they accidentally exchange lives. Edward experiences London's brutal streets while Tom struggles with royal duties. As Edward witnesses harsh injustice firsthand, he vows to rule with mercy.
